dedupe_keys.name: flood damage risk mapping inputs along the river niger upstream of niamey 2024 to 2025 slapis project crops flooded areas and settlements

description: This dataset holds the field and satellite inputs used to estimate flood risk to farms and settlements along the River Niger upstream of the city of Niamey, Niger. It was deposited on Mendeley Data in March 2025 by Maurizio Tiepolo and Giorgio Cannella for the SLAPIS project. It has three folders. Agriculture holds land cover classes for irrigated rice perimeters, pond rice, horticulture, pumpkins and sweet potatoes, with sample fields whose crops and flooding were checked on the ground in mid-February 2025. Flood Plain holds the areas flooded on 20 August 2024 and 16 February 2025, extracted from Sentinel-2 imagery with the Modified Normalized Difference Water Index, and GPS ground control points of the water edge. Human Settlements holds built-up areas within 1 km of the riverbank and on river islands, digitised from very high resolution imagery of February 2024, and buildings inside the August 2024 flooded area. The files are free to download under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: two flood dates only, and settlement mapping is by visual interpretation. Simulation uses: exposed crops and buildings for flood damage and food production loss models in the Niger valley. Related records: the Cadre Harmonisé food security data (data-cadre-harmonise-west-central-africa) give regional food insecurity context.
